Point Translate 0.12.0
• Optional floating sticky note gathers your translations. Enable it in Settings or the menu bar. • Compact yellow paper grows with your translations, with copy, remove, clear, and copy-all controls. • Translations and note position survive quitting and reopening. Drag the tape or blank paper to move it. • Always show previews now keeps the preview visible during selection drags and after copying.
Apple Silicon · macOS 26.4+. Locally Apple Development signed; not notarized.
